literal: in goodness affection absence if appears him in lineage will be doubted
translation: If a lack of affection appears in a person of otherwise good qualities, his lineage will be doubted.
modern: ஒருவனிடம் நல்ல பண்புகள் இருந்தும் அன்பு இல்லை என்பது வெளிப்பட்டால், அவனது குடிப்பிறப்பை உலகம் சந்தேகப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that affection is the defining trait of noble birth. Even if a person possesses other virtues, a lack of basic human warmth will make others question his family background. The word 'நார்' literally means fiber, but here it metaphorically represents the binding force of love and attachment.
